annotations.text:
Every measurement is from Apple's Toolbox source, Inside Macintosh, the HyperCard Stack Design Guidelines (1989) or the HyperCard 2.x reference; confidence per value is recorded in research/ and tokens/hypercard.tokens.json.

No Apple fonts, icons or code are included. Chicago renders through Krungthep/Silom (macOS) or the open Chicago Kare recreation.

For coding agents: AGENTS.md (CLAUDE.md) in the repo lists the rules. Two colors, whole pixels from tokens, 1 px borders, hard shadows, Chicago for system text, Geneva for user text, HyperCardEffects.go() for transitions, no CSS transitions, no hover.
